key_insight: CuAD transforms CUDA kernels into tangent and adjoint CUDA source, enabling accurate GPU-based sensitivities at an adjoint cost of two to six times the primal.
engineering_relevance: GPU-native discrete adjoints support aerodynamic shape optimization and data assimilation, including transonic airfoil lift and drag sensitivities.
method: Generate tangent and adjoint kernels through source-to-source automatic differentiation.
Organize reverse mode by GPU thread, assuming non-aliasing inputs and outputs.
Recompute intermediates, differentiate pure accumulations without a tape, and store remaining tape in fixed thread-local arrays.
evidence_signal: Across four flow-model kernels and a 2D Euler solver, generated derivatives passed dot-product tests to round-off; transonic NACA 0012 adjoint and tangent sensitivities agreed to 10^-13.
watch_item: Applications must respect the non-aliasing convention and account for fixed thread-local tape requirements.
paper_title: CuAD: Source-to-Source Automatic Differentiation of CUDA Kernels for Discrete Adjoints in Computational Fluid Dynamics
